comments.text:
Implement SurroundPage Vizia view with XY positioning pad and per-part controls.

DEPENDS ON: i7-49c.13 (MixerPage)

LAYOUT:
- Header: surround on/off switch, room type/size selects, global knobs (depth, ambience level/time/density/HF damp)
- Part strip: 16 part boxes + EXT, each with width and AMB send knobs, click to select
- XY Pad: large 2D pad showing all parts as draggable circles, selected part highlighted, drag to reposition (L-R on X axis, F-B on Y axis)

REFERENCE:
- web/src/SurroundPage.tsx: complete React implementation
- web/src/SurroundPage.module.css: styling
- web/src/SurroundXYPad.tsx: the 2D positioning pad with multi-part rendering

title: VST/Vizia: implement SurroundPage with XY pad
